# plakar_inventory (Resource)

An inventory — the census of resources Plakar watches over. Provider-backed inventories (aws, ovh, scaleway, gcp, vmware, k8s) discover their resources from the account they are configured against; a self-managed inventory holds resources declared by hand, e.g. with plakar_inventory_resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The Vault secret provider the references below read from (see
# plakar_secret_provider), declared here so the example stands alone.
variable "vault_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "plakar_secret_provider" "vault" {
  name        = "Vault"
  integration = "vault"
  fields = {
    url = "https://vault.example.com:8200"
  }
  fields_wo = {
    token = var.vault_token
  }
  fields_wo_version = 1
}

variable "aws_access_key" {
  type = string
}

variable "aws_secret_access_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# The fleet declared by hand: a self-managed inventory carries no
# configuration, its resources are declared with plakar_inventory_resource.
resource "plakar_inventory" "fleet" {
  name = "Fleet"
  type = "self-managed"
}

# A provider-backed inventory discovers its resources from the account it is
# configured against.
resource "plakar_inventory" "aws" {
  name = "AWS production"
  type = "aws"

  aws {
    credentials_type  = "access_key"
    access_key        = var.aws_access_key
    secret_access_key = var.aws_secret_access_key
    region            = "eu-west-1"
  }
}

# A scaleway inventory keeps its keys out of state: the access key resolved
# from Vault, the secret key write-only. Each credential takes one of three
# forms: <name>, <name>_secret or <name>_wo. Other inventory types take
# plain values only for now.
variable "scw_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "plakar_inventory" "scaleway" {
  name = "Scaleway production"
  type = "scaleway"

  scaleway {
    project_id            = "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"
    access_key_secret     = { provider = plakar_secret_provider.vault.id, path = "secret/inventories/scaleway#access_key" }
    secret_key_wo         = var.scw_secret_key
    secret_key_wo_version = 1
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the inventory.
- `type` (String) What backs the inventory: aws, ovh, scaleway, gcp, vmware, k8s or self-managed. Must match the configuration block, one of which is required for every type but self-managed.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `aws` (Block, Optional) Configuration of an aws inventory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--aws))
- `gcp` (Block, Optional) Configuration of a gcp inventory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--gcp))
- `k8s` (Block, Optional) Configuration of a k8s inventory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--k8s))
- `ovh` (Block, Optional) Configuration of an ovh inventory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--ovh))
- `scaleway` (Block, Optional) Configuration of a scaleway inventory. Each credential can be given plainly, as a reference to a secret provider (<name>_secret), or write-only (<name>_wo). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--scaleway))
- `vmware` (Block, Optional) Configuration of a vmware inventory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--vmware))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws`

Optional:

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) Access key id, when credentials_type is access_key.
- `credentials_type` (String) How to authenticate: iam or access_key.
- `region` (String) AWS region the discovery runs against.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key, when credentials_type is access_key.


<a id="nestedblock--gcp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gcp`

Optional:

- `project_id` (String)
- `service_account_json` (String, Sensitive) Service account key, as JSON. Unset falls back to ambient credentials.


<a id="nestedblock--k8s"></a>
### Nested Schema for `k8s`

Optional:

- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig granting access to the cluster. Unset falls back to in-cluster credentials.


<a id="nestedblock--ovh"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ovh`

Optional:

- `application_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `application_secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `consumer_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `endpoint` (String) OVH API endpoint, e.g. ovh-eu.


<a id="nestedblock--scaleway"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scaleway`

Optional:

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) Scaleway access key. Lands in state; see access_key_secret and access_key_wo.
- `access_key_secret` (Attributes) Resolve access_key from a secret provider each time Plakar needs it: only the path is stored. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scaleway--access_key_secret))
- `access_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only access_key: Plakar holds it, state never does. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Sent at creation, when access_key_wo_version changes, and when it replaces another form.
- `access_key_wo_version` (Number) Change this to send access_key_wo again.
- `project_id` (String)
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) Scaleway secret key. Lands in state; see secret_key_secret and secret_key_wo.
- `secret_key_secret` (Attributes) Resolve secret_key from a secret provider each time Plakar needs it: only the path is stored. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scaleway--secret_key_secret))
- `secret_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only secret_key: Plakar holds it, state never does. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Sent at creation, when secret_key_wo_version changes, and when it replaces another form.
- `secret_key_wo_version` (Number) Change this to send secret_key_wo again.

<a id="nestedatt--scaleway--access_key_secret"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scaleway.access_key_secret`

Required:

- `path` (String) Where the secret lives in the provider. For Vault: {secret_engine}/{path}#{field}. For Scaleway Secret Manager: {secret_id}#{key}, the secret's value being a JSON object that holds key.
- `provider` (String) Id of the plakar_secret_provider holding the secret.


<a id="nestedatt--scaleway--secret_key_secret"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scaleway.secret_key_secret`

Required:

- `path` (String) Where the secret lives in the provider. For Vault: {secret_engine}/{path}#{field}. For Scaleway Secret Manager: {secret_id}#{key}, the secret's value being a JSON object that holds key.
- `provider` (String) Id of the plakar_secret_provider holding the secret.



<a id="nestedblock--vmware"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vmware`

Optional:

- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `server` (String)
- `tls_ca_bundle` (String) CA bundle to verify the vSphere server against, PEM.
- `tls_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS verification of the vSphere server.
- `username` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import plakar_inventory.fleet 3f1e4a2c-9b7d-4e0f-8a11-2c5d6e7f8a90
```
